questions.question:
The following bar chart shows the numbers of white and black cars sold of 5 different brands in a city during a given year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/568e654e01be26780ddecf8a2c4f10d288cbffffa45ac2d24f7c70b732977cb1.png] 

X = Average number of black cars sold per brand.

Y = Average number of white cars sold per brand.

What is the value of Y - X?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

The number of black cars sold per brand = 96 + 114 + 121 + 109 + 120

⇒ 560

Average = 560/5

⇒ 112

The number of white cars sold per brand = 108 + 122 + 130 + 160 + 100

⇒ 620

Average = 620/5

⇒ 124

So, Y - X = 124 - 112

⇒ 12

**∴ The required answer is 12.**

questions.question:
Study the given bar graph carefully and answer the following question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be1c76975f227e248868df26a210277fd54e5d588eff034e5e60f87659fea851.png] 

What was the percentage (in%) drop in the production of food grains from 1991 to 1992?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Bar graph showing the production of food grains by a State over the years (in 1000 tons).

Production in 1991 = 60 (thousand tons)

Production in 1992 = 45 (thousand tons)

**Calculations:**

Drop in production from 1991 to 1992 = Production in 1991 - Production in 1992

Drop = 60 - 45 = 15 (thousand tons)

Percentage drop = (Drop in production / Production in the initial year) × 100

Percentage drop = (15 / 60) × 100

Percentage drop = (1 / 4) × 100

Percentage drop = 25%

**∴ The percentage drop in the production of food grains from 1991 to 1992 was 25%.**

questions.question:
The given bar given shows the income and expenditure (in ₹ lakh) of 5 companies (A, B, C, D, and E) in the year 2022. Study the graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da931058bf3032d34aca63b0bd0294f0fdca1971eb249f05102e8ed674ce1bf2.png] 

Which company earned the maximum percentage profit in the year 2022?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The income and expenditure (in ₹ lakh) of 5 companies (A, B, C, D, and E) in the year 2022.

**Formula used:**

Percentage Profit = dfrac{(Income - Expenditure)}{Expenditure} times 100

**Calculations:**

For Company B:

Income = ₹50 lakh, Expenditure = ₹40 lakh

⇒ Percentage Profit = dfrac{(50 - 40)}{40} times 100 = dfrac{10}{40} times 100 = 25% %

For Company C:

Income = ₹40 lakh, Expenditure = ₹45 lakh

⇒ Percentage Profit = dfrac{(40 - 45)}{45} times 100 = dfrac{5}{45} times 100 ≈ 11.11%%

For Company D:

Income = ₹40 lakh, Expenditure = ₹30 lakh

⇒ Percentage Profit = dfrac{(40 - 30)}{30} times 100 = dfrac{10}{30} times 100 = 33.33%%

For Company E:

Income = ₹50 lakh, Expenditure = ₹45 lakh

⇒ Percentage Profit = dfrac{(50 - 45)}{45} times 100 = dfrac{5}{45} times 100 ≈ 11.11%%

**∴ The correct answer is option 4, i.e., Company D.**

questions.question:
The bar graph given below shows the number of male teachers and female teachers in different schools.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2b257928f7afbeb5b1a1734f66719443920b8e552d3979ada172bd157ba74d5.png] 

J1 = Average number of male teachers per school

J2 = Difference between total male teachers and total female teachers

What is the value of (J1/J2)?
questions.solution:
Given

Total male teachers = 280

Total female teachers = 260

Formula used

Average = Total sum of all value/No. of all values

Solution

The average number of male teachers per school(J1)

⇒ (40 + 20 + 60 + 100 + 40 + 15 + 5)/5

⇒ 280/7 = 40

⇒ J2 = total male teachers - total female teachers

⇒ J2 = 280 - 260

⇒ J2 = 20

⇒ J1/J2 = 40/20

⇒ J1/J2 = 2

The correct option is 4.
